method.time: Job run time, start to end, from the GitHub API. Queue time is kept apart.
method.runs: Median of the measured runs, with n, min and max; a median needs n >= 3.
method.cost: Billed minutes (each job rounded up to a whole minute) times the runner's list price per minute.
method.github_cost: GitHub does not bill public repositories for this runner; its cost is what a private repository pays at GitHub's listed rate for the measured size.
method.order: One runner class at a time; at most four jobs at once within a run. One warm-up run per class first fills dependency caches.
method.selection: The project list is the whole workload list of an existing open-source CI benchmark suite, adopted before running it here. Each project is pinned to a release commit.
method.exclusions: Every run is listed. A job is left out of the medians only for the reason given next to it.
